text: A song of ascents. I Blessed are all who fear the Lord,and who walk in his ways. [AA]
What your hands provide you will enjoy;you will be blessed and prosper: [AB]
Your wife will be like a fruitful vinewithin your home,Your children like young olive plantsaround your table. [AC]
Just so will the man be blessedwho fears the Lord.
II May the Lord bless you from Zion;may you see Jerusalem's prosperityall the days of your life, [AD]
and live to see your children's children. [AE]Peace upon Israel! [AF]
